clips.title: The story
paras: Mining instructor Brock Stoneseeker rewards promising young apprentices in Thelsamar with honorary mining picks. To arrange delivery of the tools from Ironforge, he directs adventurers to enlist the aid of the local gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson.

In the dwarf town of Thelsamar, mining is more than an occupation—it is a cornerstone of daily survival and dwarven pride. Brock Stoneseeker watches dozens of fresh recruits pass through his training, drilling them on rock composition and tunnel safety. For the students who distinguish themselves above the rest, tradition demands recognition in the form of a finely crafted honorary pick. Because local supply is limited, obtaining these picks requires reaching across Khaz Modan into the heart of Ironforge.

Rather than trusting the slow, mountainous trek back through Dun Morogh on foot, Brock relies on the kingdom's aerial courier network. Thorgrum Borrelson tends the gryphon roost perched beside Thelsamar, offering rapid transit to the capital. Handing Brock's order to Thorgrum initiates a courier run that connects rural frontier training directly to the grand foundries of the dwarven capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining. And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!
I have a list of mining students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary pick. Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge. He'll get the picks ready.
The fastest way to Ironforge is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson, and speak with him about transport to Ironforge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon? Are you ready to leave for another city?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get this to Ironforge, eh? For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there. How does that sound?
